intro.created: Your projects are encrypted: only you can read them. If you forget your password, this key lets you choose a new one without losing anything.
intro.migrated: This version of GANIS encrypts your projects: only you can read them. If you forget your password, this key lets you choose a new one without losing anything.
intro.regenerated: This key replaces the previous one. It lets you choose a new password if you forget yours, without losing anything.

panel.copyFailed: The key could not be copied. Write it down by hand.
panel.saveFailed: The file could not be saved. Copy the key or write it down by hand.
panel.warningTitle: It will never be shown again.
panel.warning: Write it on paper or keep the file away from this computer. Without your password or this key, your projects will be lost for good: nobody can recover them, not even an administrator.
panel.oldKeyRevoked: The previous key no longer works.
panel.check: To confirm you wrote it down, type group no. {{number}}
panel.continue: I wrote down my key, continue

forgot.title: Forgot password
forgot.subtitle: Enter your recovery key to choose a new password. Your projects will be kept.
forgot.recoveryKeyHint: 6 groups of 6 characters. Capitals, spaces and dashes are optional.
forgot.noKey: Without your recovery key, your projects cannot be recovered.

success.title: Password changed
success.description: You can now sign in with your new password. Your projects are intact, and your recovery key is still valid.

errors.keyFormat: The recovery key must contain 6 groups of 6 characters (letters and digits).
